name: skill-bench
description: Deterministic and agent-eval bench for the React skills against Next.js and TanStack Start fixtures

scripts.fixtures:install: pnpm --dir fixtures/nextjs install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir fixtures/tanstack-start install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir fixtures/nextjs run typecheck && pnpm --dir fixtures/tanstack-start run typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --dir fixtures/nextjs run build && pnpm --dir fixtures/tanstack-start run build
